Schiff on Building a Successful Business
Schiff said dividends are high if people are willing to make some sacrifices.
The gold bug recalled his early grind, when he worked seven days a week and sixteen hours a day, ate at his desk and spent most of the time at the office.
“I tell people, if you really want to succeed in life, start a business,” he said. “You’re not going to make a lot of money as an employee, with a few exceptions.”
Schiff said that those who choose to build a business must work hard, persevere and be ready to make sacrifices.
He said entrepreneurs can’t just jet off on luxury trips or buy flashy cars whenever they want, especially in the initial phases.
“If you want to have money to start a business, you know you could go years without making money,” the
critic stated. “You might lose some money in the short run.”
Schiff said people need to make short-term sacrifices, live below their means, and stay committed for the long term.
“But if you do all those things and you’re successful, you know that the dividends will be there,” he added.
